name: Washington–Baltimore public telegraph service
summary: On 1 April 1845 the US Post Office opened Morse's Washington-Baltimore telegraph line to paying members of the public.
description: A paid public telegraph service between Washington and Baltimore operated by the Post Office on the Morse line.
